message: permissions in pnpm-workspace.yaml lets esbuild run install scripts, but depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Remove esbuild from permissions, or add it to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json

message: permissions in pnpm-workspace.yaml blocks the install scripts of sharp, but installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json allows them
fix: Remove sharp from permissions in pnpm-workspace.yaml, or move sharp from installScripts.allow to installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json if it works without its scripts
